features.detail: Every session scored against your own 42-day baseline and 30-day recovery pattern.
features.title: A recharge time built from your own history

features.detail: The nights before and after a session move the countdown within a bounded range, as they do on Garmin.
features.title: Sleep, HRV, and resting heart rate

features.detail: How hard this week has been compared with your own four-week average.
features.title: Weekly load against your 4-week average

features.detail: Override Light, Moderate, or Hard and recalculate its estimate.
features.title: Correct a session's intensity

age.detail: Sets the heart-rate ceiling every session is measured against, and how quickly the window closes.
age.title: How old are you?

bounceBack.detail: Your own read on it. Recharge starts here and replaces it with what your data shows.
bounceBack.title: After a hard session, when do you feel ready again?

experience.detail: Years of consistent training change how the same relative load lands.
experience.title: How long have you been training?

weeklyVolume.detail: Someone training six days a week is adapted to a shorter turnaround than someone training two.
weeklyVolume.title: How many sessions in a typical week?

updates.detail: The free countdown scores each session at your training level, like a Garmin does, instead of repeating your usual gap between sessions. That gap is still shown beside it.
updates.title: Standard is a recovery time again

updates.detail: Countdowns now reach four days, so a half marathon or a marathon reads longer than a long run.
updates.title: Up to four days after a race

updates.detail: Recharge reads the time you spent at each heart rate, so hard repeats cost more than a steady run at the same average, and a long easy ride no longer outweighs a hard hour.
updates.title: Intervals count for what they were

updates.detail: Train again before a countdown ends and the two combine: the longer one counts in full, plus half of the shorter. Training twice a day still reaches Ready.
updates.title: Sessions close together add up

updates.detail: Recharge+ adjusts a running countdown after each night's sleep, HRV, and resting heart rate, not only the night before the session.
updates.title: Updated by the nights after
